description: This is a JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the CredentialsMessageFilter class, focusing on message validation logic related to credentials messages in an AMQP context.

classes.name: CredentialsMessageFilterTest
classes.description: Test class that verifies the correctness of the CredentialsMessageFilter, ensuring it properly accepts or rejects messages based on their structure, headers, and content.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating a resource identifier for the credentials endpoint.

methods.name: testVerifyFailsForMissingBody
methods.description: Checks that messages without a proper body are rejected by the filter.

methods.name: testVerifyFailsForNonDataSectionBody
methods.description: Ensures that messages with bodies that are not Data sections (such as AmqpValue) are rejected.

methods.name: testVerifyFailsForMissingCorrelationId
methods.description: Verifies that messages missing reply-to or correlation identifiers are rejected.

methods.name: testVerifyFailsForUnknownAction
methods.description: Tests that messages with unknown credentials actions are rejected.

methods.name: testVerifySucceedsForValidGetAction
methods.description: Confirms that a properly formed GET credentials message with correct fields passes validation.
